name: X-Stage Song Studio PC Ready
notes: Windows 10/11 x64 ready offline portable ZIP. The LYR-only NCN head/tail analysis records every skipped filename, categorized reason and totals, then offers focused recheck of only skipped LYR files, without accessing MIDI/CUR or altering originals. Recheck preserves original reasons, confirms ongoing skips, restores repaired files into the grouped lyric index and keeps cumulative recovered reports. Paginated UI and authenticated BOM UTF-8 CSV export with spreadsheet formula-injection protection; includes exact total/progress counts and a report even if every LYR is invalid. MID/CUR checked only for confirmed lyric replacements; paired backups and undo. Extract full ZIP and run Start-Song-Studio.cmd.
